lessons.title: My daily routine
lessons.summary: Talk about what you do every day.

prompts.text: Tell me about your daily routine.
What time do you wake up, and what do you do first?
What do you usually do in the evening?

lessons.title: About me
phrases: In my free time, I like …

prompts.text: Introduce yourself: your name, where you live and who you live with.
What do you do, or what do you study?
What do you like doing in your free time?

lessons.title: Food and shopping
lessons.summary: Describe food and places to buy it.

prompts.text: What is your favourite food, and why do you like it?
Describe what you usually eat for breakfast.
Tell me about a place where you buy food.
